name: Intro
description: Introductory section pairing eyebrow + title + body text with an image, optionally with a stats sidebar. The title supports <strong> emphasis rendered in the accent color.
when_to_use: Directly after the Hero to introduce the company or topic. Use the stacked variant when key numbers should accompany the introduction; use Text instead when there is no image.
capabilities: four layouts: text-left, text-right, centered (image below), stacked with stats sidebar
accent-colored emphasis inside the title via <strong>
stats sidebar with labeled key numbers (stacked variant)

variants.description: Centered text with the image below.
Stacked layout with a stats sidebar (stats_eyebrow + stats[]).

breakpoints.mobile: Single column; image stacks under the text.

ai.prompt_summary: Intro: text + image opener section. Settings: variant (text-left|text-right|centered|stacked). Fields: eyebrow, title (supports <strong> accent), body, image + image_alt, cta_label + cta_to; stacked only: stats_eyebrow, stats[] ({ value, label }).
ai.content_guidelines: Title 4-10 words with one <strong> emphasis. Body 2-4 sentences. Stats values short (e.g. 40+, 98%), 2-4 items.

field_hints.title: Wrap the emphasized phrase in ...; it renders in the brand accent color.
field_hints.stats: Only rendered by the stacked variant.
